source("../analysis/R/kn.R")
esc <- function(x) gsub("\\$", "\\\\$", x)                  # a dollar sign starts math in Typst
holds <- sub(" of .*$", "", kn("c_spec_holds"))
SITE <- "https://erickyegon.github.io/incretin-access-value/"; APP <- "https://01a108a8-ecde-397c-5353-39196812b10c.share.connect.posit.cloud/"
tile <- function(big, cap) sprintf('block(width: 100%%, fill: rgb("#F5F5F5"), stroke: (left: 4pt + rgb("#D55E00")), inset: (x: 8pt, y: 7pt))[#text(font: "Source Serif 4", size: 21pt, weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#D55E00"))[%s] \\ #text(size: 8.8pt, fill: luma(60))[%s]]', esc(big), esc(cap))
tiles <- paste(c(tile(kn("c_att_overall"), paste0("estimated additional prescriptions per 1,000 enrollees per quarter (", kn_ci("c_att_overall"), ")")),
                 tile(paste0(kn("b_eligible"), "M"), paste0("U.S. adults meet the FDA label criteria (lower bound); ", kn("b_medicaid_elig"), "M have Medicaid")),
                 tile(paste0("$", kn("e_net5"), "M"), paste0("five-year net cost, 1 million enrollees (central case); $", kn("e_pmpm"), " per member per month")),
                 tile(paste0("All ", holds), "estimable alternative analyses give the same answer (interval excludes zero)")), collapse = ",\n  ")
li <- function(n, h, t) sprintf('grid(columns: (16pt, 1fr), gutter: 5pt, text(font: "Source Serif 4", size: 13pt, weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#D55E00"))[%d], [*%s* \\ #text(size: 9pt, fill: luma(60))[%s]])', n, h, esc(t))
steps <- paste(c(li(1, "Public data", "CMS Medicaid and Medicare Part D data, NHANES, MEPS, KFF polls, FDA labels, state Medicaid documents."),
                 li(2, "PostgreSQL and dbt", paste0(kn("build_models"), " models and ", kn("build_tests"), " tests; NDC and ICD-10 coding; every number traced to a key-numbers file.")),
                 li(3, "R analysis", "Staggered difference-in-differences, survey-weighted eligibility, budget impact model with probabilistic sensitivity analysis."),
                 li(4, "Quarto and Shiny", "Report, deck and an interactive budget model that reproduces the report's numbers.")), collapse = ",\n    ")
skills <- c("Real-world evidence", "HEOR", "Market access", "Causal inference", "Budget impact analysis", "Claims data and NDC coding", "SQL and dbt", "R, Quarto and Shiny")
chips <- paste(sprintf('#box(fill: rgb("#FFF1E6"), stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#D55E00"), inset: (x: 6pt, y: 3pt), radius: 8pt)[#text(size: 8.8pt)[%s]]', skills), collapse = " ")
lk <- function(label, url) sprintf('#text(weight: "semibold")[%s] #link("%s")[%s]', label, url, sub("^https://", "", url))
fence <- strrep(intToUtf8(96), 3)
out <- sprintf('@@F@@{=typst}
#set text(hyphenate: false)
#set par(justify: false)
#set page(numbering: none)
#block(width: 100%%, fill: rgb("#222222"), inset: (x: 14pt, y: 11pt), radius: 3pt)[
  #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#F2B999"), tracking: 0.08em)[MEDICAID COVERAGE OF OBESITY DRUGS: WHAT IT DID AND WHAT IT COULD COST] \\
  #v(2pt)
  #text(font: "Source Serif 4", size: 15pt, weight: "semibold", fill: white)[When state Medicaid programs covered Wegovy and Zepbound, prescriptions rose by an estimated %s per 1,000 enrollees per quarter] \\
  #v(2pt)
  #text(size: 9pt, fill: luma(225))[Erick Kiprotich Yegon · Epidemiologist and data scientist · #link("%s")[#text(fill: rgb("#F2B999"))[%s]]]
]
#v(4pt)
#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr), gutter: 7pt,
  %s)
#v(4pt)
#text(font: "Source Serif 4", size: 11pt, weight: "semibold")[Estimated effect of coverage on prescriptions, by quarter since coverage began]
#v(1pt)
#image("assets/10_event_study_primary_page.png", width: 100%%)
#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: luma(90))[Source: CMS State Drug Utilization Data and Medicaid enrollment; %s covering and %s never-covering jurisdictions. Part of the growth is market growth.]
#v(4pt)
#grid(columns: (1.35fr, 1fr), gutter: 16pt,
  [#text(font: "Source Serif 4", size: 12pt, weight: "semibold")[What I did] #v(3pt)
   #grid(columns: 1fr, row-gutter: 7pt,
    %s)],
  [#text(font: "Source Serif 4", size: 12pt, weight: "semibold")[Skills shown] #v(4pt)
   #block(spacing: 5pt)[%s]
   #v(5pt)
   #text(size: 9pt, fill: luma(60))[Budget impact: \\$%s million net over five years (scenario range \\$%s to \\$%s million; rebate assumed). Rebate and years 3 to 5 are assumptions; scenarios, not forecasts.]])
#v(4pt)
#line(length: 100%%, stroke: 0.6pt + luma(190))

#v(3pt)
#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: luma(80))[Public aggregate data; no company affiliation or endorsement; not patient-level claims; gross of rebates unless stated; scenarios, not forecasts. I used AI tools to help write code and documentation. The study design, methods and conclusions are my own, and I verified all results.]
@@F@@
', esc(kn("c_att_overall")), SITE, sub("^https://", "", SITE), tiles, kn("c_states_primary"), kn("c_states_never"), steps, chips, esc(kn("e_net5")), esc(kn("e_scen_min")), esc(kn("e_scen_max")),
   lk("Site:", SITE), lk("Report:", paste0(SITE, "report.html")), lk("Deck:", paste0(SITE, "deck.pdf")),
   lk("Interactive budget model:", APP), lk("Code:", "https://github.com/erickyegon/incretin-access-value"), lk("Research design pack:", paste0(SITE, "research_pack.pdf")))
cat(gsub("@@F@@", fence, out, fixed = TRUE))
